Goals: 

1- Apply Damon Archform to upper arch and coordinate lower arch however stage expansion as follows:
- maintain a symmetric archform 
- expand right side first to improve arch width
- once right side arch width achieved - expand left side with buccal root torque to ensure paltal cusps not visible on lateral view of set up 
- consctrict lower arch form bilaterally to aid cooridnation 

2- Allow 2mm proclination upper incisors, retract lowers ...as pt is class III we do not want to retract upper incisors after expansion so excess space to be closed with mesialisation 
3- IPR for space (prioritize anterior/posterior as required)
4- Conventional long rectangular attachments posteriorly 7-3, horizontal attachments anteriorly at incisal ⅓
